offerings.name: Search (/search)
offerings.pricing: $7 / 1k requests; base price includes up to 10 results. Each result above 10 adds $1 / 1k results; AI page summaries $1 / 1k pages
offerings.price_basis: PAYG，基础档（含前 10 条结果）
offerings.free_quota: New accounts get $20 in free credits (around 2,800 searches) and the Free Tier adds $10 in credits every month
offerings.output_type: 实时搜索结果（URL+页面内容）、高亮、结构化输出、AI summary
offerings.note: 计费按 pay-as-you-go，无订阅无最低消费；高速档 fast 450ms / auto ~1s / deep 4-12s。

offerings.name: Deep Search (deep-lite)
offerings.price_basis: PAYG deep-lite 档（含前 10 条结果）
offerings.note: Latency ~4 seconds, Lightweight synthesis; 额外结果与 AI 摘要按标准搜索同价。

offerings.name: Deep Search (deep)
offerings.price_basis: PAYG deep 档（含前 10 条结果）
offerings.output_type: Multi-step reasoning with structured outputs and citations
offerings.note: Latency 4–15 seconds；多步推理结构化输出。

offerings.name: Deep Search (deep-reasoning)
offerings.price_basis: PAYG deep-reasoning 档（含前 10 条结果）
offerings.output_type: Harder research tasks 的结构化研究输出

offerings.name: Answer (/answer)
offerings.output_type: An LLM answer to a question, with citations

offerings.name: Monitors (/monitors)
offerings.pricing: $15 / 1k requests; 每超出 10 条结果 $1 / 1k results; AI 页面摘要 $1 / 1k pages
offerings.price_basis: PAYG base price（含前 10 条结果）
offerings.output_type: Scheduled searches that surface new events on the web

offerings.name: Contents (/contents)
offerings.pricing: $1 / 1k pages, per content type; AI page summaries $1 / 1k pages
offerings.price_basis: PAYG per page per content type
offerings.output_type: Full page text, highlights, and summaries for known URLs
offerings.note: 每个 content type（text/highlights/summary）单独计费。

offerings.name: Agent
offerings.pricing: 固定 effort 档 $0.012–$1.00 / request（minimal $0.012 / low $0.025 / medium $0.10 / high $0.50 / xhigh $1.00）；metered 模式按用量计费（ACU $0.10/ACU, search tool call $0.005/search, email enrichment $0.02, phone $0.07），auto 默认 $5 cap，beta max 默认 $20 cap
offerings.price_basis: 固定 effort 每请求定价；metered 按用量（动态价，无法精确折算千次）
offerings.output_type: Async deep research, list building, and enrichment
offerings.note: auto 为默认 metered 模式；Connect provider 调用额外计费（如 Fiber.ai $0.02/credit）。
